_comment: Minimum new-or-updated postings over each source's trailing window. Checked separately from the daily ingest run so a missing run can be detected.

ats._comment: Whole company boards; highly variable nightly volume, so the floor only catches near-total loss.

workday._comment: Detail-fetch gate limits volume; a week of near-zero writes indicates a stalled source.

builtin-nyc._comment: HTML scraper; a three-day floor catches a blocked or broken listing page.

nyc-open-data._comment: A full feed often produces unchanged rows, so only monthly silence is suspicious.

weworkremotely._comment: Low-volume RSS feed with normal zero-posting nights.

hn-hiring._comment: Monthly hiring thread; 45 days permits publishing and scheduling slack.

unfloored.tools/ats-discover: Known ATS validation writes no posting rows and is only due every 30 days.
